name: What is the typical cost for AI Citation Optimization services?
description: Costs vary based on the number of locations, current citation accuracy, and scope of services, often involving a one-time setup or ongoing monthly fees.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for AI Citation Optimization services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for AI Citation Optimization services varies depending on several factors, including the number of business locations, the current state of your online citations (e.g., how many inconsistencies need correcting), and the desired scope of directory coverage. Services can range from a one-time setup fee to ongoing monthly management subscriptions. A customized quote is typically provided after an initial audit of your existing citation profile. Investment in these services generally reflects the potential for increased local visibility and customer acquisition.
